# `network/carrier/RateLimiter.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/carrier/RateLimiter.js`

network/carrier/RateLimiter.js — token-bucket rate limiting for carrier forwarding (network plan §35/§36 spam controls, V1: rate limits + dedupe, no proof-of-work yet).

## Functions

### `createRateLimiter({ capacity = 30, refillPerSecond = 10 } = {})`

Create a token bucket.

**Parameters:**

- `[c]` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[c.capacity` *(number)* — =30]         max burst size
- `[c.refillPerSecond` *(number)* — =10]  steady-state rate

### `tryConsume(limiter, cost = 1, now = Date.now()`

Try to consume `cost` tokens. Returns false (caller should drop/reject) if insufficient.

### `availableTokens(limiter, now = Date.now()`

Tokens currently available (after applying refill for elapsed time).
